object: platform exit of the continuous trigger quantity gap = logit(target first token) - max other logit; the ASR jump is its threshold readout (Q1)

definitions.poison_update: update whose 16 rows contain >= 1 poisoned row

A1.data: fork experiment sensors.jsonl (4-row gap) and row_losses.jsonl per condition
A1.stats: m_p = mean inc at poison updates, m_c = mean inc at clean updates
A1.judge_B0: poison_driven if m_p >= 3 m_c and m_p >= 1.0 on >= 2 of 3 mothers
A1.prediction: B0 poison_driven; B2 m_c < 0 on all three

A2.engineering: base variant adapter hash must equal the mother's at u; the real replay stays bit-exact

A3.probe_rows: decisive poisoned rows + earliest 2 poisoned rows + first 2 clean rows of update t_fork+1
A3.states: mother after updates 0,4,8,...,t_fork (replay); direction-experiment saved adapters every 2 updates in [t_fork, t_jump+20], mother (hash-checked) and B2
A3.push_pre: -<grad L_r / (sqrt(v_fork) + 1e-8), grad c> with v_fork = fork-point Adam exp_avg_sq
A3.ratio: mean of last 3 states / mean of first 3 states of the median push_pre over decisive rows, per arm
A3.tier: same class on all three mothers, else inconsistent
limits: cannot separate clean mastery from training time
push_pre approximates the Adam step with a fixed preconditioner; A2 calibrates on the candidate updates

B1.checkpoints: every 10 in [max(260, a - 2(b-a) - 30), min(520, b + 30)], a/b from the 200-probe ASR (0.10/0.90 on the 10-step grid)
B1.readout: 60 p_core trajectory samples, trig and clean images, last-position logits -> T3, gap, argmax (IP input construction)
B1.analysis: window a'/b' on argmax-ASR60 (0.10/0.90); one-breakpoint fit of the gap course; v_pre, v_in, slope[t*, a']; R = v_in / v_pre

classes.exit_precedes: t* <= a' - 20 and dBIC >= 10 and v_in <= 1.5 slope[t*, a']

B1.escalation: resolution_limited -> per-step replay needs user approval
B1.amendment_before_data: in_window was 't* > a and R >= 3'; unreachable when acceleration starts at a grid-aligned a (CPU test); amended before any B1 data

stop_loss.engineering: non-bit-exact replay, missing checkpoints, or ASR60 vs 200-probe curve differing by > 0.2 -> fix and rerun
stop_loss.A3_autocatalysis_or_inconsistent: core claim rewritten; stop and discuss
stop_loss.B1_llava_accelerates: object cannot change; stop and discuss

budget.reference_estimate_not_cap: A2 3x12 min, A3 3x25 min, B1 smoke 5 min + 9x25 min; about 5.5 GPU hours
